name: Palefox
source: The girl who used to taking care of Palefox at her shrine found dead when the Houkai Explosion happened, driving by anger Palefox took in the Source energy and gain a human body but being slowly devouring by it as well. When Kiana and Mei arrived, they tried to offer help to Palefox but it was too late and she got controlled by Source energy. After that, Kiana and Mei managed to force the Source energy out of Palefox body and help her turn back to a normal articfox. Palefox then told Mei that she will stay back here and guard the girl body who take care of her back then to the end of her life from zombies.
